#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

void solve(const string& a, ostream& out) {
    int i = 0;
    int one = 0;
    int two = 0;
    bool insideParenthesis = false;
    while (i != (int)a.length()) {
        if (a[i] == '(') {
            insideParenthesis = true;
        } else if (a[i] == ')') {
            insideParenthesis = false;
        } else if (isalpha(a[i]))
            i--;
        if (insideParenthesis) { // inside
            while (++i != (int)a.length() && a[i] != ')' && !isalpha(a[i]));
            if (i == (int)a.length() || !isalpha(a[i])) {
                continue;
            }
            while (isalpha(a[++i]));
            two++;
        } else {
            while (++i != (int)a.length() && a[i] != '(' && !isalpha(a[i]));
            if (i == (int)a.length() || !isalpha(a[i])) {
                continue;
            }
            
            int j = i;
            while (++i != (int)a.length() && isalpha(a[i]));
            one = max(one, i - j);
        }
    }
    out << one << " " << two << endl;
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    getline(cin, line);
    solve(line, cout);
    return 0;
}
